# Running a Community

As a community founder, you shape the environment your members live in.

---

## Creating a Community

1. From your dashboard, click **Create Community**
2. Give it a name and description — be clear about who it's for
3. Choose an initial template or start from defaults
4. Configure your settings
5. Publish

---

## Community Configuration

Access configuration from the **Admin** panel in your community.

### Request Types

Choose which types your community supports. Enable or disable:
- 🤝 General Help, 🚗 Rides, 🔧 Services, 📅 Events, 📦 Borrowing

For each enabled type, set a **karma multiplier** — how much karma helpers earn. Use multipliers to signal which kinds of help your community values most.

**Custom types:** If your community has specific needs (dog walking, language exchange), create custom types via the **Schema Manager** linked from your admin panel.

---

## Schema Manager — Building Custom Forms

The Schema Manager lets you design the form members fill out when posting a specific type of request. Access it from your community admin panel → **Schema Manager**.

### Creating a schema

1. Click **+ Create New Schema**
2. Choose a type name (e.g., `dog_walking`) and a label (e.g., "Dog Walking")
3. Add an icon and color, then click **Create Schema**

### Editing the form layout

The schema editor has three panels:

- **Left — Field Palette**: All available field types (Text, Number, Select, Location, Date & Time, Checkbox, and more). Drag any type into a section.
- **Middle — Canvas**: Your form sections. Drag fields from the palette to add them. Click a field to edit its label, placeholder, help text, and options. Drag fields within a section to reorder.
- **Right — Live Preview**: Exactly how the form will look to members as you build it.

### Configuring a field

Click any field on the canvas to open its editor:

| Property | Description |
|---|---|
| Label | The question members see |
| Placeholder | Example text shown inside the input |
| Help text | Extra guidance shown below the field |
| Required | Whether the field must be filled before submitting |
| Options | For dropdowns and chip selects — add/remove choices |

### Saving and publishing

- **Save Draft** — Saves your changes without making the form live.
- **Publish** — Makes the schema live. Members will see this form when they choose this request type.

You can view version history and roll back to any previous version from the **Versions** tab.

---

## Community Configuration

### Karma Mechanics

- **Decay rate (half-life):** How quickly reputation fades during inactivity
- **Minimum balance:** Whether members need minimum karma for certain request types

### Trust Mechanics

- **Depth vs. breadth:** Whether trust comes from repeated interactions with few people or many interactions across the community
- **Max trust hops:** How many degrees of separation the system considers

### Membership

- **Member cap:** Maximum size (default 150)
- **Visibility:** Public, Members Only, or Hybrid
- **Join approval:** Whether you must approve new members manually

### Onboarding

- **Karma lockout period:** How long before new members can post high-effort requests

---

## Setting the Right Culture

**Participate yourself.** Founders who actively help build trust and model the behavior they want to see.

**Welcome new members.** A short personal message to someone who just joined goes a long way.

**Handle problems early.** Address issues before they affect the community's trust in each other.
